pli-tv-kd17:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Anupiyāyaṃ viharati, Anupiyaṃ nāma Mallānaṃ nigamo.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena abhiññātā-abhiññātā Sakyakumārā bhagavantaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajanti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena Mahānāmo ca Sakko Anuruddho ca Sakko dve bhātukā honti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.6: eko hemantiko eko gimhiko eko vassiko.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.7: so vassike pāsāde cattāro māse nippurisehi turiyehi paricāriyamāno na heṭṭhā pāsādā orohati.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.8: atha kho Mahānāmassa Sakkassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.9: etarahi kho abhiññātā-abhiññātā Sakyakumārā bhagavantaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajanti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.10: amhākaṃ ca kulā n' atthi koci agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.11: yan nūnāhaṃ vā pabbajeyyaṃ Anuruddho vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.12: atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Anuruddho Sakko ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Anuruddhaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.13: etarahi tāta Anuruddha abhiññātā-abhiññātā Sakyakumārā bhagavantaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajanti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.14: amhākaṃ ca kulā n' atthi koci agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.15: tena hi tvaṃ vā pabbaja ahaṃ vā pabbajissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.1.16: ahaṃ kho sukhumālo, nāhaṃ sakkomi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.1: ehi kho te tāta Anuruddha gharāvāsatthaṃ anusāsissāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.15: atiharāpetvā āyatim pi vassaṃ evam eva kātabbaṃ, āyatim pi vassaṃ evam eva kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.20: kadā mayaṃ appossukkā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricārissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.21: na hi tāta Anuruddha kammā khīyanti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.23: akhīṇe yeva kamme pitaro ca pitāmahā ca kālaṃkatā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.24: tena hi tvaṃ ñeva gharāvāsatthena upajāna,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.26: atha kho Anuruddho Sakko yena mātā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā mātaraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.27: icchām' ahaṃ amma agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.29: evaṃ vutte Anuruddhassa Sakkassa mātā Anuruddhaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.30: tumhe kho me tāta Anuruddha dve puttā piyā manāpā appaṭikkūlā,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.31: maraṇena pi vo akāmikā vinā bhavissāmi,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.32: kim panāhaṃ tumhe jīvante anujānissāmi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.34: kho Anuruddho Sakko mātaraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.35: icchām' ahaṃ amma agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.36: anujānāhi maṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti. tumhe kho . . . pabbajjāyā 'ti. tatiyam pi kho Anuruddho Sakko mātaraṃ . . . anujānāhi maṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena Bhaddiyo Sakyarājā Sakyānaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.4: ayaṃ kho Bhaddiyo Sakyarājā Sakyānaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.6: so na ussahati agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitun ti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.8: sace tāta Anuruddha Bhaddiyo Sakyarājā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati evaṃ tvam pi pabbajāhīti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.9: atha kho Anuruddho Sakko yena Bhaddiyo Sakyarājā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhaddiyaṃ Sakyarājānaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.10: mama kho samma pabbajjā tava paṭibaddhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.11: sace te samma pabbajjā mama paṭibaddhā apaṭibaddhā sā hotu, ahaṃ tayā,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.13: ehi samma ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.14: nāhaṃ samma sakkomi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.15: yan te sakkā aññaṃ mayā kātuṃ ty āhaṃ karissāmi,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.17: mātā kho maṃ samma evam āha:
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.18: sace tāta Anuruddha Bhaddiyo Sakyarājā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati evaṃ tvam pi pabbajāhīti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.19: bhāsitā kho pana te samma esā vācā:
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.20: sace te samma pabbajjā mama paṭibaddhā apaṭibaddhā sā hotu, ahaṃ tayā,
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.22: ehi samma ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.23: tena kho pana samayena manussā saccavādino honti saccapaṭiññā.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.24: atha kho Bhaddiyo Sakyarājā Anuruddhaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.26: sattannaṃ vassānaṃ accayena ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.28: nāhaṃ sakkomi satta vassāni āgametun ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.35: ekassa vassassa accayena ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.37: nāhaṃ sakkomi ekaṃ vassaṃ āgametun ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.39: sattannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.41: nāhaṃ sakkomi satta māse āgametun ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.52: āgamehi samma sattāhaṃ yāvāhaṃ putte ca bhātare ca rajjaṃ niyyādemīti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.1: atha kho Bhaddiyo ca Sakyarājā Anuruddho ca Ānando ca Bhagu ca Kimbilo ca Devadatto ca Upālikappakena sattamā yathā pure ca pure ca caturaṅginiyā senāya uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanti evam eva caturaṅginiyā senāya niyyiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.2: te dūraṃ gantvā senaṃ nivattetvā paravisayaṃ okkamitvā ābharaṇaṃ omuñcitvā uttarāsaṅge bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā Upālikappakaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.5: atha kho Upālissa kappakassa nivattantassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.7: iminā kumārā nippātitā 'ti ghātāpeyyum pi maṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.8: ime hi nāma Sakyakumārā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissanti,
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.10: bhaṇḍikaṃ muñcitvā taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ rukkhe ālaggetvā yo passati dinnaṃ ñeva haratū 'ti vatvā yena te Sakyakumārā ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.11: addasāsuṃ kho te Sakyakumārā Upālikappakaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.14: idha me ayyaputtā nivattantassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.19: so kho ahaṃ ayyaputtā bhaṇḍikaṃ muñcitvā taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ rukkhe ālaggetvā yo passati dinnaṃ ñeva haratū 'ti vatvā tato 'mhi paṭinivatto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.20: suṭṭhu bhaṇe Upāli akāsi yam pi na nivatto,
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.23: atha kho te Sakyakumārā Upālikappakaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.24: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te Sakyakumārā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.26: ayaṃ bhante Upālikappako amhākaṃ dīgharattaṃ paricārako.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.28: imassa mayaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ karissāma,
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.30: atha kho bhagavā Upālikappakaṃ paṭhamaṃ pabbājesi, pacchā te Sakyakumāre.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.31: atha kho āyasmā Bhaddiyo ten' eva antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi,
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Bhaddiyo araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udāneti:
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.3: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.5: āyasmā bhante Bhaddiyo araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udāneti:
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.7: nissaṃsayaṃ kho bhante āyasmā Bhaddiyo anabhirato 'va brahmacariyaṃ carati
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.8: taṃ ñeva vā purimaṃ rajjasukhaṃ samanussaranto araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udāneti:
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.10: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.11: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena Bhaddiyaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.5.13: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Bhaddiyo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Bhaddiyaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.1: evaṃ āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Bhaddiyo tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Bhaddiyaṃ bhagavā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.3: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Bhaddiya araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.6: kiṃ pana tvaṃ Bhaddiya atthavasaṃ sampassamāno araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.8: pubbe me bhante rañño sato anto pi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā hoti bahi pi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā hoti anto pi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā hoti bahi pi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā hoti anto pi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā hoti.
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.9: so kho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ rakkhito gopito pi santo bhīto ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrasto viharāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.10: etarahi kho panāhaṃ bhante araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhīto anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrasto appossukko pannalomo paradavutto migabhūtena cetasā viharāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.11: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante atthavasaṃ sampassamāno araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānemi:
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.13: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Anupiyāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Kosambī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kosambī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.4: atha kho Devadattassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.5: kin nu kho ahaṃ pasādeyyaṃ yasmiṃ me pasanne bahu lābhasakkāro uppajjeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.7: ayaṃ kho Ajātasattukumāro taruṇo c' eva āyatiṃ bhaddako ca.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.9: tasmiṃ me pasanne bahu lābhasakkāro uppajjissatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.10: atha kho Devadatto senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Rājagahaṃ tena pakkāmi,
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.12: atha kho Devadatto sakavaṇṇaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā kumārakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā ahimekhalikāya Ajātasattussa kumārassa ucchaṅge pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.13: atha kho Ajātasattukumāro bhīto ahosi ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrasto.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.14: atha kho Devadatto Ajātasattuṃ kumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.19: sace kho tvaṃ bhante ayyo Devadatto iṅgha saken' eva vaṇṇena pātubhavassū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.20: atha kho Devadatto kumārakavaṇṇaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā saṃghāṭipattacīvaradharo Ajātasattussa kumārassa purato aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.21: atha kho Ajātasattukumāro Devadattassa iminā iddhipāṭihāriyena abhippasanno pañcahi rathasatehi sāyaṃpātaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati pañca ca thālipākasatāni bhattābhihāro abhiharīyati.
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.22: atha kho Devadattassa lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtassa pariyādinnacittassa evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji:
pli-tv-kd17:2.1.24: saha cittuppādā 'va Devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihāyi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.1: tena kho pana samayena Kakudho nāma Koḷiyaputto āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālaṃkato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno,
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.3: seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā Māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni,
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.4: so tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena n' eva attānaṃ na paraṃ vyābādheti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.5: atha kho Kakudho devaputto yenāyasmā Mahāmoggallāno ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.6: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Kakudho devaputto āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.7: Devadattassa bhante lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtassa pariyādinnacittassa evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji:
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.9: saha cittuppādā 'va bhante Devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.11: idaṃ vatvā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.12: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.13: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.14: Kakudho nāma bhante Koḷiyaputto mama upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālaṃkato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno,
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.16: seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā Māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni,
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.17: so tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena n' eva attānaṃ na paraṃ vyābādheti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.18: atha kho bhante Kakudho devaputto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.19: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhante Kakudho devaputto maṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.24: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyīti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.25: kim pana te Moggallāna Kakudho devaputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.26: yaṃ kiñci Kakudho devaputto bhāsati sabban taṃ tath' eva hoti no aññathā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.27: cetasā ceto paricca vidito me bhante Kakudho devaputto
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.28: yaṃ kiñci Kakudho devaputto bhāsati sabban taṃ tath' eva hoti no aññathā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.2.31: idāni so moghapuriso attanā 'va attānaṃ pātukarissati. ||2||
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.1: pañc' ime Moggallāna satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.3: idha Moggallāna ekacco satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlo 'mhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.5: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlo 'mhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.6: mayañ c' eva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāss' assa manāpaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.7: yaṃ kho pan' assa amanāpaṃ kathaṃ naṃ mayan tena samudācareyyāma.
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.9: yaṃ tumo karissati tumo 'va tena paññāyissatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.10: evarūpaṃ kho Moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.11: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. ||3||
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.1: puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh' ekacco satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvo 'mhīti paṭijānāti parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.3: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvo 'mhīti paṭijānāti . . . asaṃkiliṭṭho 'ti. mayaṃ c' eva
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.4: kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāss' assa manāpaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.8: evarūpaṃ kho Moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati.
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.10: puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh' ekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesano 'mhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhā me dhammadesanā . . .
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.19: puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh' ekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo 'mhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.28: puna ca paraṃ Moggallāna idh' ekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassano 'mhīti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.37: ime kho Moggallāna pañca satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.38: ahaṃ kho pana Moggallāna parisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlo 'mhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.39: na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.40: na cāhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.44: parisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassano 'mhīti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.45: na ca maṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti
pli-tv-kd17:2.4.46: na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.1: atha kho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.4: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.6: Devadattassa bhante Ajātasattukumāro pañcahi rathasatehi sāyaṃpātaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.9: yāva kīvañ ca bhikkhave Devadattassa Ajātasattukumāro pañcahi rathasatehi sāyaṃpātaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissati pañca ca thālipākasatāni bhattābhihāro abhiharīyissati hāni yeva bhikkhave Devadattassa pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuḍḍhi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave caṇḍassa kukkurassa nāsāyaṃ pittaṃ bhindeyyuṃ, evaṃ hi so bhikkhave kukkuro bhiyyosomattāya caṇḍataro assa,
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.11: evam eva kho bhikkhave yāva kīvañ ca Devadattassa Ajātasattukumāro pañcahi rathasatehi sāyaṃpātaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissati pañca ca thālipākasatāni bhattābhihāro abhiharīyissati hāni yeva bhikkhave Devadattassa pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuḍḍhi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.12: attavadhāya bhikkhave Devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi parābhavāya Devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kadalī attavadhāya phalaṃ deti parābhavāya phalaṃ deti
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.14: evam eva kho bhikkhave attavadhāya Devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi parābhavāya Devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.15: seyyathāpi bhikkhave veḷu attavadhāya phalaṃ deti parābhavāya phalaṃ deti
pli-tv-kd17:2.5.19: seyyathāpi bhikkhave assatarī attavadhāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti parābhavāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti sarājikāya parisāya.
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.2: atha kho Devadatto uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.3: jiṇṇo dāni bhante bhagavā vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto,
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.4: appossukko dāni bhante bhagavā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ anuyutto viharatu mama bhikkhusaṃghaṃ nissajjatu,
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.6: alaṃ Devadatta mā te rucci bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pariharitun ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.8: tatiyam pi kho Devadatto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.12: Sāriputtamoggallānānam pi kho ahaṃ Devadatta bhikkhusaṃghaṃ na nissajjeyyaṃ, kim pana tuyhaṃ chavassa kheḷāpakassā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.14: sarājikāya maṃ bhagavā parisāya kheḷāpakavādena apasādeti Sāriputtamoggallāneva ukkaṃsatīti
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.15: kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.16: ayañ ca tarahi Devadattassa bhagavati paṭhamo āghāto ahosi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Devadattassa Rājagahe pakāsaniyakammaṃ karotu
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.3: pubbe Devadattassa aññā pakati ahosi idāni aññā pakati,
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.4: yaṃ Devadatto kareyya kāyena vācāya na tena buddho vā dhammo vā saṃgho vā daṭṭhabbo, Devadatto 'va tena daṭṭhabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.8: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho Devadattassa Rājagahe pakāsaniyakammaṃ kareyya
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.16: yassāyasmato khamati Devadattassa Rājagahe pakāsaniyassa kammassa karaṇaṃ
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.24: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.25: tena hi tvaṃ Sāriputta Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsehīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.26: pubbe mayā bhante Devadattassa Rājagahe vaṇṇo bhāsito
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.29: nanu tayā Sāriputta bhūto yeva Devadattassa Rājagahe vaṇṇo bhāsito
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.32: evam eva kho tvaṃ Sāriputta bhūtaṃ ñeva Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsehīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.2.33: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavato paccassosi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Sāriputtaṃ sammannatu Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsetuṃ
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.7: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.9: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ sammanneyya Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsetuṃ
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.20: sammato saṃghena āyasmā Sāriputto Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsetuṃ
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.24: sammato āyasmā Sāriputto sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ Rājagahaṃ pavisitvā Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsesi
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.27: tattha ye te manussā assaddhā appasannā dubbuddhino te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.28: usuyyakā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā, Devadattassa lābhasakkāraṃ usuyyantīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.29: ye pana te manussā saddhā pasannā paṇḍitā buddhimanto te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.3.30: na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati yathā bhagavā Devadattaṃ Rājagahe pakāsāpeti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.1: atha kho Devadatto yena Ajātasattukumāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Ajātasattukumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.2: pubbe kho kumāra manussā dīghāyukā, etarahi appāyukā,
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.3: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ tvaṃ kumāro 'va samāno kālaṃ kareyyāsi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.4: tena hi tvaṃ kumāra pitaraṃ hantvā rājā hohi,
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.7: ayyo kho Devadatto mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo, jāneyyāti ayyo Devadatto 'ti
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.8: ūruyā potthanikaṃ bandhitvā divādivassa bhīto ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrasto sahasā antepuraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.9: addasāsuṃ kho antepure upacārakā mahāmattā Ajātasattukumāraṃ divādivassa bhītaṃ ubbiggaṃ ussaṅkiṃ utrastaṃ sahasā antepuraṃ pavisantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.11: te vicinantā ūruyā potthanikaṃ baddhaṃ disvā Ajātasattukumāraṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:3.4.17: kumāro ca hantabbo Devadatto ca sabbe ca bhikkhū hantabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.1: atha kho te mahāmattā Ajātasattukumāraṃ ādāya yena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.3: ekacce deva mahāmattā evaṃ matiṃ akaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.4: kumāro ca hantabbo Devadatto ca sabbe ca bhikkhū hantabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.14: kiṃ bhaṇe karissati buddho vā dhammo vā saṃgho vā.
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.15: nanu bhagavatā paṭigacc' eva Devadatto Rājagahe pakāsāpito
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.18: tattha ye te mahāmattā evaṃ matiṃ akaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.22: ye te mahāmattā evaṃ matiṃ akaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.27: ye te mahāmattā evaṃ matiṃ akaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.33: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro Ajātasattukumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.5.36: sace kho tvaṃ kumāra rajjena atthiko, etaṃ te rajjan ti Ajātasattussa kumārassa rajjaṃ niyyādesi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.1: atha kho Devadatto yena Ajātasattukumāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Ajātasattukumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.2: purise mahārāja āṇāpehi ye samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ jīvitā voropessantīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.4: yathā bhaṇe ayyo Devadatto āha tathā karothā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.5: atha kho Devadatto ekaṃ purisaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.6: gacchāvuso, amukasmiṃ okāse samaṇo Gotamo viharati,
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.7: taṃ jīvitā voropetvā iminā maggena āgacchā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.9: yo iminā maggena eko puriso āgacchati taṃ jīvitā voropetvā iminā maggena āgacchathā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.11: ye iminā maggena dve purisā āgacchanti te jīvitā voropetvā iminā maggena āgacchathā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.13: ye iminā maggena cattāro purisā āgacchanti te jīvitā voropetvā iminā maggena āgacchathā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.6.15: ye iminā maggena aṭṭha purisā āgacchanti te jīvitā voropetvā āgacchathā 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.1: atha kho so eko puriso asicammaṃ gahetvā dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato avidūre bhīto ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrasto patthaddhena kāyena aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.2: addasā kho bhagavā taṃ purisaṃ bhītaṃ ubbiggaṃ ussaṅkiṃ utrastaṃ patthaddhena kāyena ṭhitaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.3: disvāna taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca: ehi
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.5: atha kho so puriso asicammaṃ ekamantaṃ karitvā dhanukalāpaṃ nikkhipitvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.6: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ yo 'haṃ duṭṭhacitto vadhakacitto idh' ūpasaṃkanto,
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.7: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.8: taggha tvaṃ āvuso accayo accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ duṭṭhacitto vadhakacitto idh' ūpasaṃkanto.
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.9: yato ca kho tvaṃ āvuso accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tan te mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma,
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.10: vuḍḍhi h' esā āvuso ariyassa vinaye
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.11: yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.12: atha kho bhagavā tassa purisassa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.13: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.16: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.17: evam eva tassa purisassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.18: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.19: atha kho so puriso diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.21: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.24: es' āhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.25: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.26: atha kho bhagavā taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.7.27: mā kho tvaṃ āvuso iminā maggena gaccha, iminā maggena gacchāhīti aññena maggena uyyojesi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.2: kiṃ nu kho so eko puriso cirena āgacchatīti
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.3: paṭipathaṃ gacchantā addasaṃsu bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.4: disvāna yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.6: aparappaccayā satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.8: upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.9: atha kho bhagavā te purise etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.10: mā kho tumhe āvuso iminā maggena gacchittha, iminā maggena gacchathā 'ti aññena maggena uyyojesi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.11: atha kho te cattāro purisā kin nu kho te dve purisā cirena āgacchantīti . . . aññena maggena uyyojesi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.12: atha kho te aṭṭha purisā kin nu kho te cattāro purisā cirena āgacchantīti . . . aññena maggena uyyojesi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.8.14: kin nu kho te aṭṭha purisā cirena āgacchantīti . . .
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.1: atha kho so eko puriso yena Devadatto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Devadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.2: nāhaṃ bhante sakkomi taṃ bhagavantaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.5: mā kho tvaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ jīvitā voropesi,
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.6: aham eva samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ jīvitā voropessāmīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.7.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā Gijjhakūṭassa pabbatassa pacchāyāyaṃ caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.8: atha kho Devadatto Gijjhakūṭaṃ pabbataṃ abhirūhitvā mahantaṃ silaṃ pavijjhi
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.10: dve pabbatakūṭā samāgantvā taṃ silaṃ sampaṭicchiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.11: tatopapatikā uppatitvā bhagavato pāde ruhiraṃ uppādesi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.12: atha kho bhagavā uddhaṃ ulloketvā Devadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.13: bahuṃ tayā moghapurisa apuññaṃ pasutaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ duṭṭhacitto vadhakacitto tathāgatassa ruhiraṃ uppādesīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.9.15: idaṃ bhikkhave Devadattena paṭhamaṃ ānantarikakammaṃ upacitaṃ yaṃ duṭṭhacittena vadhakacittena tathāgatassa ruhiraṃ uppāditan ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.3: te 'dha bhikkhū bhagavato virassa parito -parito caṅkamanti uccāsaddā mahāsaddā sajjhāyaṃ karontā bhagavato rakkhāvaraṇaguttiyā.
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.4: assosi kho bhagavā uccāsaddaṃ mahāsaddaṃ sajjhāyasaddaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.6: kin nu kho so Ānanda uccāsaddo mahāsaddo sajjhāyasaddo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.9: te 'dha bhante bhikkhū bhagavato vihārassa . . . rakkhāvaraṇaguttiyā,
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.10: so eso bhagavā uccāsaddo mahāsaddo sajjhāyasaddo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.11: tena h' Ānanda mama vacanena te bhikkhū āmantehi:
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.13: evam bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.15: evam āvuso 'ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.16: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.17: aṭṭhānam etaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yo parūpakkamena tathāgataṃ jīvitā voropeyya,
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.42: ime bhikkhave satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.49: na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.50: aṭṭhānam etaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yo parūpakkamena tathāgataṃ jīvitā voropeyya,
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe Nālāgiri nāma hatthī caṇḍo hoti manussaghātako.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.2: atha kho Devadatto Rājagahaṃ pavisitvā hatthisālaṃ gantvā hatthibhaṇḍe etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.3: mayaṃ kho bhaṇe rājañātakā nāma paṭibalā nīcaṭhāniyaṃ ucce ṭhāne ṭhapetuṃ bhattam pi vetanam pi vaḍḍhāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.4: tena hi bhaṇe yadā samaṇo Gotamo imaṃ racchaṃ paṭipanno hoti tadā imaṃ Nālāgiriṃ hatthiṃ muñcitvā imaṃ racchaṃ paṭipādethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te hatthibhaṇḍā Devadattassa paccassosuṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.6: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi,
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.7: atha kho bhagavā taṃ racchaṃ paṭipajji.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.8: addasāsuṃ kho te hatthibhaṇḍā bhagavantaṃ taṃ racchaṃ paṭipannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.9: disvāna Nālāgiriṃ hatthiṃ muñcitvā taṃ racchaṃ paṭipādesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.10: addasā kho Nālāgiri hatthī bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.11: disvāna soṇḍaṃ ussāpetvā pahaṭṭhakaṇṇavālo yena bhagavā tena abhidhāvi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.12: addasāsuṃ kho te bhikkhū Nālāgiriṃ hatthiṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.14: ayaṃ bhante Nālāgiri hatthī caṇḍo manussaghātako imaṃ racchaṃ paṭipanno,
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.21: tatiyam pi kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā pāsādesu pi hammiyesu pi chadanesu pi ārūḷhā acchanti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.2: tattha ye te manussā assaddhā appasannā dubbuddhino te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.3: abhirūpo vata bho mahāsamaṇo nāgena viheṭhiyissatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.4: ye pana te manussā saddhā pasannā paṇḍitā buddhimanto te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.5: cirassaṃ vata bho nāgo nāgena saṃgāmessatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.6: atha kho bhagavā Nālāgiriṃ hatthiṃ mettena cittena phari.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.7: atha kho Nālāgiri hatthī bhagavato mettena cittena phuṭṭho soṇḍaṃ oropetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato purato aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.8: atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇena hatthena Nālāgirissa hatthissa kumbhaṃ parāmasanto Nālāgiriṃ hatthiṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.13: mā ca mado mā ca pamādo,
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.14: na hi pamattā sugatiṃ va- janti te,
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.17: atha kho Nālāgiri hatthī soṇḍāya bhagavato pādapaṃsūni gahetvā upari muddhani ākiritvā paṭikuṭito paṭisakki yāva bhagavantaṃ addakkhi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.18: atha kho Nālāgiri hatthī hatthisālaṃ gantvā sake ṭhāne aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.19: tathā danto ca pana Nālāgiri hatthī ahosi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.12.20: tena kho pana samayena manussā imaṃ gāthaṃ gāyanti:
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.2: yāva pāpo ayaṃ Devadatto alakkhiko, yatra hi nāma samaṇassa Gotamassa evaṃ mahiddhikassa evaṃ mahānubhāvassa vadhāya parakkamissatīti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.5.1: tena kho pana samayena Devadatto pahīnalābhasakkāro sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā -viññāpetvā bhuñjati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.7: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā kulesu viññāpetvā-viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.8: kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ, kassa sāduṃ na ruccatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.9: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānam,
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.10: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.11: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā-viññāpetvā bhuñjissatīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.13: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Devadatta sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā -viññāpetvā bhuñjasīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.17: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññāpessāmi tayo atthavase paṭicca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.19: pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, mā pāpicchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṃghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.1: atha kho Devadatto yena Kokāliko Kaṭamorakatissako Khaṇḍadeviyā putto Samuddadatto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Kokālikaṃ Kaṭamorakatissakaṃ Khaṇḍadeviyā puttaṃ Samuddadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.2: etha mayaṃ āvuso samaṇassa Gotamassa saṃghabhedaṃ karissāma cakkabhedan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.3: evaṃ vutte Kokāliko Devadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.4: samaṇo kho āvuso Gotamo mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.5: kathaṃ mayaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa saṃghabhedaṃ karissāma cakkabhedan ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.6: etha mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā pañca vatthūni yācissāma:
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.7: bhagavā bhante anekapariyāyena appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa viriyārambhassa vaṇṇavādī.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.8: imāni bhante pañca vatthūni anekapariyāyena appicchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya dhutatāya pāsādikatāya apacayāya viriyārambhāya saṃvattanti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.9: sādhu bhante bhikkhū yāvajīvaṃ āraññakā assu, yo gāmantaṃ osareyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.10: yāvajīvaṃ piṇḍapātikā assu, yo nimantanaṃ sādiyeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.11: yāvajīvaṃ paṃsukūlikā assu, yo gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.12: yāvajīvaṃ rukkhamūlikā assu, yo channaṃ upagaccheyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.13: yāvajīvaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ na khādeyyuṃ, yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.15: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi janaṃ saññāpessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.16: sakkā kho āvuso imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samaṇassa Gotamassa saṃghabhedo kātuṃ cakkabhedo,
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.1: atha kho Devadatto sapariso yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Devadatto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.9: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.11: yo icchati āraññako hotu, yo icchati gāmante viharatu,
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.12: yo icchati piṇḍapātiko hotu, yo icchati nimantanaṃ sādiyatu,
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.13: yo icchati paṃsukūliko hotu, yo icchati gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyatu.
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.14: aṭṭha māse kho mayā Devadatta rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ anuññātaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.18: na bhagavā imāni pañca vatthūni anujānātīti
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.19: haṭṭho udaggo sapariso uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.20: atha kho Devadatto sapariso Rājagahaṃ pavisitvā pañcahi vatthūhi janaṃ saññāpesi:
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.21: mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā pañca vatthūni yācimhā:
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.26: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.28: imāni pañca vatthūni samaṇo Gotamo nānujānāti,
pli-tv-kd17:3.15.29: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samādāya vattāmā 'ti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.1: tattha ye te manussā assaddhā appasannā dubbuddhino te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.2: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhutā sallekhavuttino,
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.3: samaṇo pana Gotamo bahulliko bāhullāya cetetīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.4: ye pana te manussā saddhā pasannā paṇḍitā buddhimanto te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.5: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto bhagavato saṃghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.8: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto saṃghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.10: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Devadatto saṃghabhedāya parakkamasi cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.15: yo kho Devadatta samaggaṃ saṃghaṃ bhindati kappaṭṭhikaṃ kibbisaṃ pasavati kappaṃ nirayamhi paccati,
pli-tv-kd17:3.16.16: yo ca kho Devadatta bhinnaṃ saṃghaṃ samaggaṃ karoti brahmaṃ puññaṃ pasavati kappaṃ saggamhi modati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.2: addasā kho Devadatto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.3: disvāna yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.4: ajjatagge dān' āhaṃ āvuso Ānanda aññatr' eva bhagavatā aññatr' eva bhikkhusaṃghā uposathaṃ karissāmi saṃghakammaṃ karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.5: atha kho āyasmā Ānando Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.7: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.8: addasā kho maṃ bhante Devadatto Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.9: disvāna yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.12: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd17:3.17.16: pāpam ariyehi dukkaran ti. ||17||3|| bhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.1: atha kho Devadatto tadah' uposathe uṭṭhāyāsanā salākaṃ gāhesi:
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.2: mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā pañca vatthūni yācimhā:
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.7.1: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.10: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samādāya vattāma.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.11: yassāyasmato imāni pañca vatthūni khamanti so salākaṃ gaṇhatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.12: tena kho pana samayena Vesālikā Vajjiputtakā pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni navakā c' eva honti apakataññuno ca,
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.13: te ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthu sāsanan ti salākaṃ gaṇhiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.14: atha kho Devadatto saṃghaṃ bhinditvā pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni ādāya yena Gayāsīsaṃ tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.15: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.16: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.17: Devadatto bhante saṃghaṃ bhinditvā pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni ādāya yena Gayāsīsaṃ tena pakkanto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.18: na hi nāma tumhākaṃ Sāriputtā tesu navakesu bhikkhūsu kāruññam pi bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.19: gacchatha tumhe Sāriputtā purā te bhikkhū anayavyasanaṃ āpajjantīti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.20: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Sāriputtamoggallānā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena Gayāsīsaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.21: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bhagavato avidūre rodamāno ṭhito hoti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.22: atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.24: ye pi te bhante bhagavato aggasāvakā Sāriputtamoggallānā te pi Devadattassa santike gacchanti Devadattassa dhammaṃ rocentā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.25: aṭṭhānam etaṃ bhikkhu anavakāso yaṃ Sāriputtamoggallānā Devadattassa dhammaṃ roceyyuṃ, api ca te gatā bhikkhusaññattiyā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena Devadatto mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.2: addasā kho Devadatto Sāriputtamoggallāne dūrato 'va āgacchante,
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.4: passatha bhikkhave yāva svākkhāto mayā dhammo, ye pi te samaṇassa Gotamassa aggasāvakā Sāriputtamoggallānā te pi mama santike āgacchanti
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.6: evaṃ vutte Kokāliko Devadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.8: pāpicchā Sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.10: svāgataṃ tesaṃ yato me dhammaṃ rocentīti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.11: atha kho Devadatto āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ upaḍḍhāsanena nimantesi:
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.13: alaṃ āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto aññataraṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.14: āyasmāpi kho Mahāmoggallāno aññataraṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.15: atha kho Devadatto bahud eva rattiṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ ajjhesi:
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.17: paṭibhātu taṃ āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhūnaṃ dhammī kathā, piṭṭhī me āgilāyati tam ahaṃ āyamissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.18: evaṃ āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto Devadattassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.19: atha kho Devadatto catugguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena seyyaṃ kappesi,
pli-tv-kd17:4.2.20: tassa kilantassa muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa muhuttaken' eva niddā okkami. ||2||
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.1: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto ādesanāpāṭihāriyānusāsaniyā bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya ovadi anusāsi,
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.2: āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno iddhipāṭihāriyānusāsaniyā bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya ovadi anusāsi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.3: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āyasmatā Sāriputtena ādesanāpāṭihāriyānusāsaniyā āyasmatā Mahāmoggallānena iddhipāṭihāriyānusāsaniyā ovadiyamānānaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.4: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.5: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.7: yo tassa bhagavato dhammaṃ roceti so āgacchatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.8: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni ādāya yena Veḷuvanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.10: uṭṭhehi āvuso Devadatta, nītā te bhikkhū Sāriputtamoggallānehi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.11: nanu tvaṃ āvuso Devadatta mayā vutto:
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.13: pāpicchā Sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.3.14: atha kho Devadattassa tatth' eva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggañchi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.1: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.3: sādhu bhante bhedakānuvattakā bhikkhū puna upasampajjeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.5: mā te rucci bhedakānuvattakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ punaupasampadā.
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.6: tena hi tvaṃ Sāriputta bhedakānuvattake bhikkhū thullaccayaṃ desāpehi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.7: kathaṃ pana te Sāriputta Devadatto paṭipajjīti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.8: yath' eva bhante bhagavā bahud eva rattiṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā maṃ ajjhesati:
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.10: paṭibhātu taṃ Sāriputta bhikkhūnaṃ dhammī kathā, piṭṭhī me āgilāyati taṃ ahaṃ āyamissāmīti,
pli-tv-kd17:4.4.11: evam eva kho bhante Devadatto paṭipajjīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.4: te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbāhitvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.5: tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya c' eva hoti balāya ca
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.6: na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.7: tesaṃ yeva kho pana bhikkhave mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇakā bhiṅkacchāpā
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.8: te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbāhitvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.9: tesaṃ taṃ n' eva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.10: tatonidānañ ca maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.11: evam eva kho bhikkhave Devadatto mamānukubbaṃ kapaṇo marissatīti.

pli-tv-kd17:4.7.1: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.3: lābhena bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho,
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.11: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto . . . atekiccho.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.12: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya-abhibhuyya vihareyya, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.19: kiñ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya-abhibhuyya vihareyya, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.26: yaṃ hi 'ssa bhikkhave uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya-abhibhuyya viharato evaṃ 'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.33: uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya-abhibhuyya viharato evaṃ 'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.34: imaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya-abhibhuyya vihareyya, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.41: tasmāt iha bhikkhave uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya-abhibhuyya viharissāma, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.48: evañ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.49: tīhi bhikkhave asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.51: pāpicchatā, pāpamittatā, oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpādi.
pli-tv-kd17:4.7.52: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi asaddhammehi abhibhūto . . . atekiccho 'ti. ||7||

pli-tv-kd17:5.1.18: ekato Upāli tayo honti ekato cattāro aṭṭhamo anussāveti salākaṃ gāheti
pli-tv-kd17:5.1.19: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthu sāsanaṃ imaṃ gaṇhatha imaṃ rocethā 'ti:
pli-tv-kd17:5.1.20: evam pi kho Upāli saṃgharāji hoti no ca saṃghabhedo.
pli-tv-kd17:5.1.21: ekato Upāli cattāro honti ekato cattāro navamo anussāveti . . .
pli-tv-kd17:5.1.23: evaṃ kho Upāli saṃgharāji c' eva hoti saṃghabhedo ca.
pli-tv-kd17:5.1.24: navannaṃ vā Upāli atirekanavannaṃ vā saṃgharāji c' eva hoti saṃghabhedo ca.
pli-tv-kd17:5.1.25: na kho Upāli bhikkhunī saṃghaṃ bhindati api ca bhedāya parakkamati, na sikkhamānā . . .,
